capture.source: GET /api/v1/tracks?limit=50 from python -m apps.webui.server --prod over the lyrics-words e2e fixture library
capture.scenario: Two-track library built by tests/e2e/support/lyrics_words_fixture.py, then python -m apps.lyrics index over the same data dir. Track A carries a vocal verdict and aligned words; track B carries 3 cached lyric lines, no lyric_verdict row and no stems, so the listing reports effective unknown with n_lines 3 (VOCALS-FILTER-01), the openair shape behind LYR-13.
